{{Quote|I almost pity the poor Devaronian. But you should know&mdash;Gholan is not your average prisoner. He knows the key's valuable. Plus he's trained in the Force, and highly violent. The Republic tried executing him four times. That's when they shipped him to Belsavis. Now Gholan thinks he can't die. '''Gholan''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was imprisoned in [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A crazed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] with some training, Gholan somehow survived four execution attempts by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], forcing the Republic to send him to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Gholan stole the key to [[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] [[Ellis Ruger]]'s guard station, and refused all of the Empire's offers to trade for the key. As a result, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Medechas]] dispatched Imperial forces to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Gholan and retrieve the key.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gholan appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is the target of the Imperial mission "Fifth Time's the Charm."<ref name="TOR" />
